notes: Primary layer; same as layers[0]. {y} = tile row (0 = north), {x} = tile column (0 = lon -180). Matrix at zoom z: 2^(z+1) columns x 2^z rows.

layers.title: LRO WAC global mosaic (303 ppd)
layers.crs: EPSG:4326-like equirectangular (plate carree, urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::104903, Moon sphere R=1737.4 km), longitude east-positive
layers.attribution: Imagery: NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University (LRO WAC), served by NASA Solar System Treks (Moon Trek)
layers.notes: Tested 2026-11-14: z0 (0/0/1.jpg), z2 (2/1/3.jpg) and z8 (8/255/300.jpg) return HTTP 200 greyscale 256x256 JPEGs. {y} is the TileRow (0 = north), {x} the TileCol (0 = lon -180). z9 returns 404. Capabilities: https://trek.nasa.gov/tiles/Moon/EQ/LRO_WAC_Mosaic_Global_303ppd_v02/1.0.0/WMTSCapabilities.xml. Tiles are greyscale; data are 1-band so they can be tinted client-side.

south_polar_stereographic.notes: Moon Trek advertises polar projections (urn:ogc:def:crs:IAU2000::30120 = south pole), but the layer name under https://trek.nasa.gov/tiles/Moon/SP/ could not be determined in the time available (guessed names returned 404). Use the equirectangular layer; re-check via the Moon Trek API page https://trek.nasa.gov/tiles/apidoc/trekAPI.html?body=moon (South Pole section).
